post.summary:
Request abandonment of a pending canonicalization candidate whose
transaction will never land on-chain (issue #319).
post.description:
The request records an abandon *intent* and returns `202 Accepted`;
the delta stays a candidate — the account stays locked — until the
canonicalization worker confirms over the abandon quarantine that the
transaction did not land, then discards the delta as
`client_abandoned` and releases the account (typically well under a
minute, versus the full submission grace + retry window).

Refused with `GUARDIAN_CANDIDATE_LANDED` (409) when the transaction
already landed. Retries are idempotent and preserve the original
request timestamp. Poll `GET /delta` for the resolution: still
`candidate` → waiting; `canonical` → landed after all; `discarded`
with reason `client_abandoned` → abandoned.

get.summary:
Public, unauthenticated liveness + identity probe. Returns the
server's version, git commit, environment, start time, and uptime.
Consumed by wallet clients (pre-auth health check) and the status
homepage. Exposes no account, operator, or auth data.

413.description: Request body exceeds the configured size limit

nonce.description:
Nonce of the candidate delta to abandon. Requiring the explicit
target prevents a stale request from releasing a newer candidate.

abandon_requested_at.description:
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the recorded abandon request. Retries
return the original timestamp; absent once resolved.

state.description:
`"pending"` while the worker still has to resolve the intent
(the account stays locked until then); `"abandoned"` once the
delta is discarded as client-abandoned and the account released.

missing_permissions.description:
Lex-sorted permissions the operator lacks. Present only for
`GUARDIAN_INSUFFICIENT_OPERATOR_PERMISSION`.

paused_at.description: RFC 3339 pause timestamp. Present only for `GUARDIAN_ACCOUNT_PAUSED`.

released_at.description:
RFC 3339 timestamp of the guardian-switch release. Present only
for `GUARDIAN_ACCOUNT_RELEASED`.

retry_after_secs.description:
Seconds to wait before retrying. Present only for
`rate_limit_exceeded` (the `Retry-After` header carries the same value).

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same request could plausibly succeed.

ApiErrorResponse.description:
Wire shape of a Guardian error response body: `{ code, message, meta }`
(feature `009-human-readable-errors`). Mirrors the object produced by
[`crate::error::GuardianError`]'s `IntoResponse` impl and carried
identically on the gRPC `Status.details`. The legacy `success`/`error`
fields are gone; the diagnostic detail is logged server-side only.
Documented as the body of every non-2xx response.

code.description:
Stable, machine-readable error code (e.g. `account_not_found`). The
client branch + i18n key. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description:
Short, user-safe message; safe to display verbatim. Wording is not
part of the stable contract.

amount.description:
Signed decimal magnitude (e.g., `"+100"`, `"-50"`) for fungible
holdings. Absent for non-fungible holdings where the detail
view uses `added` / `removed` lists instead.

Auth.description:
Authentication and authorization handler
Defines which signature scheme to use and handles verification
Each variant contains auth-specific authorization data

initial_state.description: Opaque, schema-free JSON blob describing the initial account state.

CosignerSignature.description: Cosigner signature entry for delta proposals

DashboardDeltaCategory.description:
Closed, stable enumeration of action categories. Adding a value is
a wire-contract change.

DeltaMetadata.description:
Persisted activity metadata for a canonical delta. Stored as JSONB
in the `deltas.metadata` column. `None` for EVM deltas and any
historical row never reprocessed by [`build_metadata`].

assets.description:
Assets surfaced in deterministic order. Empty when the
transaction does not move an asset or extraction failed.
Multi-asset transactions populate every extractable entry so
clients do not show a misleading single-asset summary.

oneOf.description:
Counterparty of the transaction. `None` for transactions
without a clear sender/recipient (admin ops, swaps, etc.).

Multisig proposal intent lifted from the matching
`delta_proposals` row at push time. Absent for single-key
`push_delta`, EVM deltas, and pushes where no proposal matched.

delta_payload.description: Opaque, schema-free JSON payload describing the state delta.

oneOf.description:
Typed dashboard metadata derived at push time. Stored as JSONB
in the `deltas.metadata` column. `None` for EVM deltas and any
historical row never reprocessed by the push-time pipeline.

abandon_confirm_count.description:
Consecutive worker ticks that observed the on-chain commitment
still at this candidate's base after the abandon was requested.
Reset on a divergent observation, so only an unbroken streak
counts — the same stale-RPC shield as `divergence_count`.

abandon_requested_at.description:
RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the client's abandon request
(issue #319). While set, the status remains `candidate` — the
account stays locked — until the canonicalization worker
resolves the intent after the abandon quarantine.

divergence_count.description:
Consecutive canonicalization ticks that observed the on-chain
commitment at neither this delta's `prev_commitment` nor its
expected new commitment — i.e. the account advanced past the
state this candidate was built on. Reset to zero whenever a
read shows the account still at the candidate's base, so only
an unbroken streak counts. Requiring more than one observation
before discarding shields against stale RPC reads.

DiscardReason.description:
Why a delta ended in `Discarded`. Absent on discards that predate
the field (and on the worker's retry/divergence discards, which
delete the delta instead of transitioning it).

LookupAccount.description:
Single match in a lookup response. Wraps `account_id` so the response shape
can be extended in a forward-compatible way (e.g. adding role tags or
per-account metadata) without breaking existing clients.

ProposalMetadata.description:
Operator-stated intent lifted from a matching proposal. Mirrors
`ProposalMetadataPayload` in `crates/miden-multisig-client/src/payload.rs`
field-for-field.

note_type.description:
P2ID note visibility, `"public"` or `"private"` (issue #322).
Absent => public (pre-#322 proposals).

proposal_type.description:
One of the validated multisig proposal types (`add_signer`,
`remove_signer`, `change_threshold`, `update_procedure_threshold`,
`p2id`, `consume_notes`, `switch_guardian`). Free string so new
types from the multisig client don't force a wire-contract bump
here — `category` is the closed enum.

public_key.description: Hex-encoded ECDSA public key (required for signature preparation)

state_json.description: Opaque, schema-free JSON blob describing the account state.

StatusResponse.description: Response body for `GET /status`. Safe to expose unauthenticated.

environment.description:
Deployment environment / network label, e.g. `"testnet"`. Same
value surfaced on `GET /dashboard/info`.

git_commit.description: Short git SHA at build time (`"unknown"` when unavailable).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 wall-clock time the process started.

status.description: Constant `"ok"`. A 200 response is itself the liveness signal.

uptime_seconds.description: Whole seconds since `started_at`; clamped to 0 on clock skew.
